calculate_depth_metrics: calculate depth estimation metrics like RMSE, MAE, and SILog between ground truth and predicted depth tensors
run_depth_evaluation: run depth evaluation by computing a1, a2, a3 accuracy thresholds on predicted versus ground truth depth maps
create_depth_metric: create a DepthMetric dataclass with a name and is_lower_better flag to define custom depth evaluation metrics
test_depth_metric_is_better: test the DepthMetric is_better method to compare two metric values and determine which is superior
review_depth_metrics_tuple: review the DEPTH_METRICS tuple containing all ten standard depth evaluation metrics with their directionality
